per_case_results.question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
per_case_results.actual_sql:

FROM "superhero" "sh"
INNER JOIN "hero_power" "hp" ON "sh"."id" = "hp"."hero_id"

WHERE "sh"."superhero_name" = '3-D Man'

per_case_results.question: Among the superheroes with the super power of "Super Strength", how many of them have a height of over 200cm?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Super Strength' AND T1.height_cm > 200
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM "superhero" 
JOIN "hero_power" ON "superhero"."id" = "hero_power"."hero_id"

WHERE "superpower"."power_name" = 'Super Strength'

per_case_results.question: Rank superheroes from Marvel Comics by their eye color popularity, starting with the most common color.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT colour.colour AS EyeColor, COUNT(superhero.id) AS Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(superhero.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS PopularityRank FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id INNER JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' GROUP BY colour.colour

per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT AVG("height_cm") FROM "superhero"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: What is Abomination's superpower?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "sp"."power_name"
FROM "hero_power" "hp"
JOIN "superpower" "sp" ON "hp"."power_id" = "sp"."id"
WHERE "hp"."hero_id" = 1
LIMIT 10;

-- Note: The schema provided doesn't include a hero table with superhero_name column. This query assumes Abomination has hero_id = 1. If there's a hero table with superhero_name, the WHERE clause should be: JOIN "hero" ON "hp"."hero_id" = "hero"."id" WHERE "hero"."superhero_name" = 'Abomination'

per_case_results.question: Which hero was the fastest?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "s"."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero" "s"
JOIN "hero_attribute" "ha" ON "s"."id" = "ha"."hero_id"
JOIN "attribute" "a" ON "ha"."attribute_id" = "a"."id"
WHERE "a"."attribute_name" = 'Speed'
ORDER BY "ha"."attribute_value" DESC
LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: State all of 3-D Man's attributes along with their values.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T3.attribute_name, T2.attribute_value FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "full_name", "superhero_name", "height_cm", "weight_kg", "eye_colour_id", "hair_colour_id", "skin_colour_id", "gender_id", "race_id", "publisher_id", "alignment_id"
FROM "superhero"
WHERE "superhero_name" = '3-D Man'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Which superheroes have blue eyes with brown hair?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.hair_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Blue' AND T3.colour = 'Brown'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "superhero"."superhero_name"
FROM "superhero"
JOIN "colour" "eye_colour" ON "superhero"."eye_colour_id" = "eye_colour"."id"
JOIN "colour" "hair_colour" ON "superhero"."hair_colour_id" = "hair_colour"."id"
WHERE "eye_colour"."colour" = 'Blue'
AND "hair_colour"."colour" = 'Brown'
LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: What is the publisher for Hawkman, Karate Kid and Speedy?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT "publisher"."publisher_name"
FROM "superhero"
JOIN "publisher" ON "superhero"."publisher_id" = "publisher"."id"
WHERE "superhero"."superhero_name" IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Calculate the percentage of superheroes with blue eyes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(T1.id), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN "eye_colour_id" = 7 THEN 1 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM "superhero"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Find the ratio between male superheroes and female superheroes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Male' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.gender = 'Female' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END), 0) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "gender_id" = 1 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "gender_id" = 2 THEN 1 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM "superhero"
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Provide the eye colour of the superhero who has Karen Beecher-Duncan as their full name.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.colour FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
per_case_results.actual_sql:

per_case_results.question: In superheroes with missing weight data, calculate the difference between the number of superheroes with blue eyes and no eye color.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.weight_kg = 0 OR T1.weight_kg IS NULL
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN "c"."id" = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN "c"."id" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "difference"
FROM "superhero" "s"
JOIN "colour" "c" ON "s"."eye_colour_id" = "c"."id"
WHERE "s"."weight_kg" = 0 OR "s"."weight_kg" IS NULL
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: How many green-skinned villains are there in the superhero universe?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN alignment AS T2 ON T1.alignment_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.alignment = 'Bad' AND T3.colour = 'Green'
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "colour" c ON s."skin_colour_id" = c."id"
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
WHERE c."colour" = 'Green' AND a."alignment" = 'Bad'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Which publisher created more superheroes: DC or Marvel Comics? Find the difference in the number of superheroes.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dc_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS marvel_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
WHERE p."publisher_name" IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')
LIMIT 500
